name: dsh-sidebar-footer-stack
description: Stacks the sidebar's bottom-left footer entries vertically instead of squeezing them into one horizontal row. The core sidebar (dsh-client-ui-sidebar) renders slot 'sidebar.footer.action' as div._footerActions { display:flex } with no flex-direction, so every plugin that registers there (remote bridge, usage/billing, update, ...) shares the same 264px row: labels truncate ('Re...') and a wide card drops into its own @container degraded form. The core has no config switch for this and every skin would need its own override, so this plugin injects one suffix-stable rule through the webserver/index-inject seam — [class*="_footArea"] > [class*="_footerActions"] { flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch } with width:100% on each entry — wrapped in a container query so the collapsed rail keeps the core layout, and with a :not(:has(> * + *)) fallback so a single entry stays horizontal. Works for every theme; ships a zero-UI client half that only verifies the rule is in effect (window.__dshSidebarFooterStack.report()).
